name: Princess Body AS ~ Harami Hime-Tachi no Koukyuu Monogatari
original_name: プリンセスボディAS～孕み姫たちの後宮物語
source:
Beautiful princess Arin was violated by a gang of mercenaries. While her lover
Herriam spent months away killing others, she was brutalized into depravity at
home. She got pregnant and had an illegitimate daughter, Aqua. When he found
out, Herriam vengefully impregnated Aqua.

By then all decency was gone from the royal family.

Harrium built a harem of fornicating pregnant women. It became a hedonist's
paradise known as Herriam's Kingdom. Arin and Aqua competed for the queen's
throne of this debauched mini empire.

Aqua used her youth to win. But Arin called an even more beloved princess from the castle...

Her name was Ranza... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE080645.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
美丽公主阿琳遭一群佣兵侵犯。恋人赫里亚姆远征数月、在外杀戮时，她在家中饱受凌辱，最终彻底堕落。阿琳怀孕并生下一名私生女阿库娅。赫里亚姆得知真相后，为报复又令阿库娅怀孕。

此时，王室早已不剩半分廉耻。

赫里亚姆建立了一座由交媾孕妇组成的后宫，那里成为享乐主义者的天堂，人称“赫里亚姆王国”。阿琳与阿库娅彼此争夺这个堕落小帝国的王后宝座。

阿库娅凭借青春占据上风，阿琳却从城堡召来一位更加受宠的公主……

她名叫兰莎……
